description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act. No 16 of 2023 Repatriation of Expert Proceeds in to Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette contains rules issued by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, No. 16 of 2023, specifically addressing the repatriation and conversion of export proceeds. The content establishes regulatory requirements for exporters and licensed banks, defines key terms, and repeals previous rules. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments issued by a regulatory authority.
